value: Tax-exempt private foundation described in IRC Section 501(c)(3); separate legal entity from Dupaco Community Credit Union with its own Board of Directors and officers
quote: The Foundation is a separate legal entity from Dupaco Community Credit Union (the “Credit Union”) and is governed by its own Board of Directors and officers.

value: 2011, to honor the retirement of Robert W. "Bob" Hoefer
quote: The Foundation was established in 2011 to honor the retirement of 47-year employee and long-time Dupaco Community Credit Union President and CEO, Robert W. “Bob” Hoefer.

value: $250,000 to 35 nonprofit organizations across Iowa, Illinois and Wisconsin
quote: The Dupaco Foundation awarded $250,000 in grants to 35 nonprofit organizations across Iowa, Illinois and Wisconsin.
